blocks.title: Framework
blocks.text: Software engineering mein framework tasawwurat, tareeqon aur tools ka ek mayaari (standardized) aur dobara istemal hone wala (reusable) majmooa hai jo software applications banane ke liye ek munazzam bunyad deta hai.

Framework pehle se bane hue hisse (predefined components) aur banawatein (architectures) deta hai jo khaas software kaam banana aasan karte hain, to developers aam hal dobara ijad karne ki bajaye apni application ke khaas code par tawajjo de sakte hain. Frameworks kaarkardagi, yaksaniyat (consistency) aur code ke dobara istemal ko barhate hain, jis se software ka majmooi maiyar aur maintainability behtar hoti hai.

blocks.title: Misal
blocks.text: Website banane ke liye sara code shuru se likhne ki bajaye aap Django jaisa framework istemal kar sakte hain. Django mein user login, database management aur page templates jaisi tayyar features hoti hain, jaise ghar banane ke liye sab kuch khud design karne ki bajaye pehle se bana naqsha (blueprint) istemal karna.

blocks.prompt: SDLC ke silsile mein framework ka kya kirdar hai (MCQ 3)?
blocks.explanation: Pehle se bane hisson aur banawaton ke saath munazzam bunyad dena: option (b). Kitab ki answer key (c), 'hardware sambhalna', deti hai jo text se mel nahi khata.

items: Framework: software banane ke liye munazzam bunyad dene wala tasawwurat, tareeqon aur tools ka mayaari, dobara istemal hone wala majmooa.
Tayyar hisse deta hai (Django: login, database, templates); kaarkardagi, yaksaniyat, dobara istemal aur maiyar barhata hai.
